UserBackup.title: UserBackup
UserBackup.description: Per-user academic and profile snapshot for cross-device backup and automatic sign-in restore across Android and Web/iOS PWA.

lecturesCount.description: Total number of backed-up timetable lectures.

assessmentsCount.description: Total number of backed-up exams and assignments.

flashcardsCount.description: Total number of backed-up SM-2 flashcards.

profileSettings.description: Bounded list (max 40) of key=value profile and preference entries.

courseRecords.description: Bounded list (max 50) of pipe-delimited course records.

lectureRecords.description: Bounded list (max 80) of pipe-delimited timetable lecture records.

assessmentRecords.description: Bounded list (max 80) of pipe-delimited exam and assignment records.

flashcardRecords.description: Bounded list (max 100) of pipe-delimited SM-2 flashcard records.

noteRecords.description: Bounded list (max 80) of pipe-delimited study note records.

gradeRecords.description: Bounded list (max 60) of pipe-delimited GPA course grade records.

expenseRecords.description: Bounded list (max 100) of pipe-delimited campus expense records.

StudyRoom.title: StudyRoom
StudyRoom.description: Real-time cross-town and cross-platform (Android + iPhone/Browser PWA) live study stage with host moderation, waiting room, whiteboard lock, live pop-quiz polls, and WebRTC voice bridge.

ownerId.description: UID of the student hosting the study room.

ownerName.description: Display name of the room host.

courseCode.description: Course code associated with the session (e.g., CSC 301).

roomTitle.description: Title of the live study session.

focusTopic.description: Current chapter, exam topic, or Pomodoro goal.

visibility.description: Access scope: CAMPUS (public lobby + code), UNLISTED (cross-town invite code / URL only), PRIVATE (solo vault).

joinCode.description: 6-character alphanumeric invite code for cross-town and browser joining.

timerEndEpochMillis.description: UTC epoch millis when RUNNING countdown reaches zero.

timerRemainingSeconds.description: Remaining countdown seconds when IDLE or PAUSED (0..43200).

sharedBoardNote.description: Collaborative live whiteboard / key formulas note (0..2000 chars).

waitingRoomEnabled.description: When true, non-host guests enter WAITING admissionStatus until admitted by host.

whiteboardLocked.description: When true (Lecture Mode), only Host or Co-Hosts can edit sharedBoardNote.

coHostIds.description: Bounded list (max 10) of promoted Co-Host UIDs.

voiceRoomUrl.description: Zero-cost Jitsi WebRTC room URL for live voice, camera, and slide screen-sharing across Android and iPhone browsers (0..200 chars).

activePollQuestion.description: Live stage pop-quiz or poll question pushed by Host/Co-Host (0..300 chars).

activePollOptions.description: Bounded list (max 4) of poll answer choices (A/B/C/D).

activePollCorrectIndex.description: Correct option index (0..3) for pop-quiz polls, or -1 for open opinion polls.

activePollRevealed.description: Whether the host has revealed the correct poll answer to the stage.

spotlightCardText.description: Synchronized flashcard or exam question pinned to the top stage spotlight (0..600 chars).

SharedFlashcard.title: SharedFlashcard
SharedFlashcard.description: Peer-contributed active-recall flashcard inside a live study room.

roomOwnerId.description: Denormalized ownerId of the parent StudyRoom for O(1) list rule evaluation.

roomVisibility.description: Denormalized visibility of the parent StudyRoom for O(1) list rule evaluation.

authorId.description: UID of the student sharing this flashcard.

authorName.description: Display name of the flashcard author.

RoomParticipant.title: RoomParticipant
RoomParticipant.description: Live Meet-style participant tile state (presence, city/campus, platform badge, waiting room admission, live poll vote, hand raise, emoji reaction) inside a study room.

roomOwnerId.description: Denormalized ownerId of the parent StudyRoom for O(1) list rule evaluation.

roomVisibility.description: Denormalized visibility of the parent StudyRoom for O(1) list rule evaluation.

userId.description: UID of the joined participant matching document ID and request.auth.uid.

displayName.description: Display name of the participant (1..80 chars).

cityOrCampus.description: Optional location/campus badge (0..80 chars) showing cross-town collaboration.

studyStatus.description: Current live activity state of the scholar.

handRaised.description: Whether the participant has raised their hand for a question.

reactionEmoji.description: Latest live reaction emoji pulse (0..16 chars).

focusMinutesLogged.description: Minutes focused during this live session (0..10000).

admissionStatus.description: Waiting room and moderation status controlled by Host/Co-Host.

pollVoteIndex.description: Selected option index (0..3) for active stage poll, or -1 if unvoted.

devicePlatform.description: Platform indicator badge shown on live participant tile.

RoomMessage.title: RoomMessage
RoomMessage.description: Real-time study room chat, Q&A question, or key insight message.

roomOwnerId.description: Denormalized ownerId of the parent StudyRoom for O(1) list rule evaluation.

roomVisibility.description: Denormalized visibility of the parent StudyRoom for O(1) list rule evaluation.

authorId.description: UID of the message author matching request.auth.uid.

authorName.description: Display name of the message author (1..80 chars).

/user_backups/{userId}.description: Strictly private per-user academic, profile, and settings backup keyed by UID.

/study_rooms/{roomId}.description: Live collaborative campus, cross-town invite-code, and browser-accessible study rooms.

/study_rooms/{roomId}/shared_cards/{card.description: Shared flashcard deck items contributed inside a live study room.

/study_rooms/{roomId}/participants/{part.description: Live Meet-style participant tiles with presence, waiting room state, poll votes, hand raise, and reactions.

/study_rooms/{roomId}/messages/{messageI.description: Live collaborative Q&A and study chat messages inside a study room.
